narrative:
## Handover Summary — Traffic & Revenue

Volume and price per message validated by product and market; ML proposals accepted or overridden by controllers.

## Key Decisions
• Norway campaign SMS stepped down 6% for RCS / WhatsApp cannibalisation
• OTP International AIT volume removed (9 destinations)
• Central Europe WhatsApp bundles added to the forecast

## Recommendation for Termination Phase
Load the Nordic operator increases into the rate table before re-forecasting January.

signals.title: Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January
signals.source: Operator notices (Telenor, Telia, Telia Finland) — Carrier & Termination Cost phase
signals.excerpt: Termination cost is NOK 5,773M, 77% of revenue. Routing absorbs part of the increase; the remainder must be passed through in Enterprise SMS pricing to protect GP per message.
